hints: There is a power of 10, a square and a square root. Turn each one into an ordinary number first.
Multiply 3 by your value of 4². Then go from left to right: subtract that from 10³, then add √64.

solution.methodName: PEMDAS: brackets, powers, × ÷ left to right, + − left to right

steps.why: A power of 10 is 1 followed by that many zeros.

trapNotes.60: This reads 10³ as 100: 100 − 48 + 8 = 60. 10³ has three zeros, so it is 1,000.
trapNotes.864: This multiplies before squaring: (3 × 4)² = 12² = 144, then 1,000 − 144 + 8 = 864. The power belongs only to the 4, so 4² = 16 comes first.
